---
name: Feature proposal
description: Propose a focused improvement to WelcomeScore
title: "feature: "
labels: ["enhancement", "needs triage"]
assignees: []
---

## Problem to solve

What concrete contributor, maintainer, or visitor problem does this address?

## Proposed outcome

Describe the smallest useful user-facing outcome. Avoid prescribing an implementation unless it is essential to the proposal.

## Why this fits WelcomeScore

Explain how it supports evidence-bound repository guidance, explicit user control, contributor onboarding, accessibility, privacy, or maintainability.

## Safety and data impact

Could this collect data, use a third-party service, require new secrets, change a public write flow, automate an action, or affect the Dev Lounge? If so, describe the minimum necessary behavior and user control.

## Alternatives considered

What simpler approach, existing feature, or documentation change could solve the same problem?

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The proposed user outcome is observable and testable.
- [ ] The change preserves explicit user control and documented privacy boundaries.
- [ ] The scope and validation plan are clear enough for a contributor to begin.

## Additional context

Link related issues, mockups, or references. Do not include secrets, private repository information, personal data, or vulnerability details.
